programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.sub-title: Across the lake Vierwaldstättersee with the “Unterwalden”
programme.desc: Lake Lucerne in the heart of Switzerland stretches from the foothills of the Alps to the first three-thousand-meter peaks of the high mountains. Home waters of the paddle steamer Unterwalden. For two and a half years she was not on the water. Now, after the biggest renovation in her history, the life of the 110-year-old paddle steamer is starting all over again. Her first voyages, with all the imponderables and challenges for the crew, take her into a diverse, wild landscape, right into the mystical heart of Switzerland. In their territory, scenic contrasts collide: barren high moorland and gently rolling alpine meadows, modern tourist resorts and quiet mountain villages, caves hidden deep in the earth and snow-covered two-thousand-meter peaks. The Unterwalden is part of the oldest and largest fleet of paddle steamers so high above the sea. Here on Lake Lucerne, according to national legend, the three original cantons swore eternal allegiance to each other over seven hundred years ago. A land around which countless myths entwine and whose lifeline since the opening of the Gotthard Pass in the thirteenth century was the shipping traffic on the lake.

programme.title: Fuerteventura: The golden beauty of the Canaries
programme.desc: Fuerteventura, the second largest of the Canary Islands, is located just 120 kilometres off the coast of West Africa. The climate is extremely dry and the struggle for water has always been a major setback. Then, around a century ago, returning US emigrants brought what were then modern wind turbine water pumps from the Aermotor Windmill Company with them to Fuerte-ventura. Today, the environmentally friendly and so-called “Chicago’s”, experience a renaissance. Unfortu-nately, original spare parts in good condition are diffi-cult to come by. When Leocadio Araya Sanchez began planting countless cacti on a barren hillside a few years ago, people thought he was mad. His idea was to make a healthy juice drink from the prickly pears – with great success. But getting the fruit to release its pre-cious superfood juice is no simple task. On an almost daily basis, Marcos Tapia is magnetically attracted to one of the paradisiacal beaches of the island. The 44-year-old is Spanish champion and vice world champion in para-body board surfing. When he was 28. Marcos was involved in a serious motorbike accident and has been paraplegic ever since.

programme.title: Fuerteventura: The golden beauty of the Canaries
programme.desc: Fuerteventura, the second largest of the Canary Islands, is located just 120 kilometres off the coast of West Africa. The climate is extremely dry and the struggle for water has always been a major setback. Then, around a century ago, returning US emigrants brought what were then modern wind turbine water pumps from the Aermotor Windmill Company with them to Fuerte-ventura. Today, the environmentally friendly and so-called “Chicago’s”, experience a renaissance. Unfortu-nately, original spare parts in good condition are diffi-cult to come by. When Leocadio Araya Sanchez began planting countless cacti on a barren hillside a few years ago, people thought he was mad. His idea was to make a healthy juice drink from the prickly pears – with great success. But getting the fruit to release its pre-cious superfood juice is no simple task. On an almost daily basis, Marcos Tapia is magnetically attracted to one of the paradisiacal beaches of the island. programme.title: Sri Lanka - Tropics, temples and tea plantations
programme.desc: Sri Lanka stands for colourful diversity in all respects. If it's spirituality or Ayurveda you're looking for, here it is. Adventurers and nature lovers can also satisfy their needs here. No one must travel far to discover exotic worlds on this drop-shaped tropical island. "mareTV" delves into the day to day lives of the is-landers, some of whom pursue the most unusual pro-fessions: Uditha Lakmaal is a palm tree climber. He harvests the sap of the trees, known as palm wine, by climbing to the top of them. Sri Lankan stilt fishermen now actually have very little to do with fish and func-tion more as models receiving payment from tourists for acting the part. Anulawathie runs a small floating hoop business, offering car inner tubes for adults and tuk-tuk tubes for children. Different varieties of tea can be found on Herman Gunaratnes tea plantation. Just four carefully selected women are allowed to harvest the exclusive white tea grown there. Each tea leaf is cut individually from the bush by gloved hands and with golden scissors.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: Magic Lakes
programme.desc: At 117 square kilometres, the Müritz is the largest lake on German territory, but it’s far from the only one in the north east of the country. Even the Mecklenburg Lake District, between Waren and Feldberg, contains around 2 lakes alone. Thanks to the Müritz National Park the species diversity is particularly high in the region: half of the German crane population breeds in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern; the osprey is typical of the Müritz area; the lively Eurasian otter hunts here; and the endangered red milan circles the skies above. Fred Bollmann knows the national park like hardly any other. The former ranger and voluntary nature conservationist is actively involved in the preservation of ‘his’ wildlife world. Filming for this production took two years. The outcome is a unique portrait of this stunning region.

programme.title: Wild River Rhine
programme.desc: Alluvial forests, roaring waterfalls, steep canyons and sunny slopes flank the river Rhine. The variety of habitats is the reason for the large biodiversity along the stream.There is hardly any other river in Germany that is surrounded by as many myths and legends as the river Rhine. No other river has been the topic of songs, has been painted and travelled equally frequently. Despite this it still seems to be true today what the French poet Victor Hugo once said about this river – the Rhine is a river everybody talks about, nobody explores, everybody visits but no one really knows. The film follows the water against the stream. It starts at the river’s delta in the Netherlands, flows through six countries and ends in the Swiss Alps.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The air wants to flee the heat, but is too weak. It hovers just above the ground, heavy and weighed down by the oven-like heat. It turns wanly around itself, and tries to cool off by liquefying itself. It vibrates, it oscillates – but there is no escape. This is West Africa in late March. The Harmattan, the hot desert wind of the Sahara, is blowing without respite. It has no pity with the people who live here. Whoever wants to go from one place to another has to travel on roads that hardly deserve this name. They are dusty paths that don’t appear on any map. They are maneuverable only with great effort and for a few months of the year. They are impassable during the rainy season, since they are washed over by the Niger River, one of the mightiest rivers in the world. When it starts to rain, the roads turn into muddy paths. Every journey is a trip into uncertainty.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The air wants to flee the heat, but is too weak. It hovers just above the ground, heavy and weighed down by the oven-like heat. It turns wanly around itself, and tries to cool off by liquefying itself. It vibrates, it oscillates – but there is no escape. This is West Africa in late March. The Harmattan, the hot desert wind of the Sahara, is blowing without respite. It has no pity with the people who live here. programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: They run through deserts, through ice and snow, deep into the jungle, along the water and over the mountains. The landscapes through which these routes wind are unique and exert their never-ending fascination even on regular travellers. In our documentary “Hot Roads – An Icebound Road” which is part of the five-part film series “Hot Roads” we want to tell the stories that take place along the route itself, of the people who live along it and for whom the road is part and parcel of their personal destiny.

programme.title: Wild Holland - The Living Delta
programme.desc: The film celebrates the diverse natural heritage of the Dutch delta region while sketching the cultural context that has played such a vital part in shaping it. Using cutting edge cinematic techniques ranging from eagle’s eye aerial views to unprecedented underwater scenes, 'Wild Holland - The Living Delta' presents a portrait of this unique wetland area of Europe as never seen before, capturing it in an important moment of change - a time when new life is flooding back into the delta.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these car routes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured!

programme.title: Antarctica - Tales from the End of the World
programme.desc: The Antarctic region is undoubtedly one of the most remote and inhospitable, yet one of the most beautiful landscapes of the world. This documentary takes us on a journey to the stormy isolated islands of the Southern Ocean. Seals, penguins, seabirds and numerous other animals live and breed in this hostile environment and harsh climate. Only by an icebreaker can we reach the remote coasts of the Antarctic continent where Emperor Penguins defy the life-threatening environment of the vast ice desert at the end of the world.

programme.title: Women Above the Clouds
programme.sub-title: A Helicopter Heroine in the Himalayas

programme.title: Germany's Mystic Forest
programme.desc: 2.000 rivers and streams dig deep into the underground and transport their water into reservoirs or "Germany's Wild Amazon", the Wupper. These forests and rivers, together with heathlands and moors, are home to a diverse fauna. Martens, badgers, wild boars, hares, roe deer, and red deer, even black grouse and hazel deer find shelter in these parts. Wolves also have a dominant presence, not to mention those who live underground, such as lizards, bats, and snakes. Accompany us on a journey where we explore every corner of this rugged land. Climb underground into the Bergisches Land, through the vast hidden cave systems that sprawl far beneath the forests. There is also much to be discovered in the water, dive with us in crystal clear streams and rivers with their diverse flora and fauna.

programme.title: Air Collision
programme.desc: Una tempesta solare spazza via il sistema di controllo del traffico aereo. I passeggeri dell'Air Force One e quelli di un jet di linea si ritrovano in rotta di collisione nei cieli sopra il Midwest.

programme.title: Airplane vs. Volcano
programme.desc: Un aereo di linea rimane intrappolato all'interno di un anello di vulcani in eruzione. I passeggeri e l'equipaggio devono trovare un modo per sopravvivere ad alta quota, senza atterrare. Quando, però, la lava e le ceneri scatenano paura e sfiducia tra tutti, non sono solo i vulcani a essere pericolosi. Tutti devono imparare a collaborare se vogliono sopravvivere a questo epico volo di fuoco.

programme.title: Blackout - Invasion Earth
programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo, la Russia viene colpita da un blackout. Ogni comunicazione è interrotta, le città sono al buio. Nella nuova e inquietante dimensione d'isolamento milioni di persone impazziscono e muoiono per cause sconosciute. Chi si nasconde dietro il disfacimento della nazione e il collasso del mondo intero? A una squadra di eroi, il compito di salvare quel che rimane dell'umanità.

programme.title: The Recall - L'invasione
programme.desc: Charlie (RJ Mitte) si unisce ai suoi amici durante un weekend, in una cabina sul lago. Quella notte, un raggio di luce ultraterrena spunta giù dal cielo e rapisce gran parte del gruppo, portandolo sulla nave madre. I due superstiti, Charlie e Annie, devono fare affidamento su un eccentrico e misterioso cacciatore locale (Wesley Snipes), che sembra avere già esperienze dell'attacco.

programme.title: Frontier - Ai confini del tempo
programme.desc: Il giovane e cinico Mikhail ha dedicato tutta la sua vita al lavoro sacrificando ogni tipo di relazione, fin quando un incontro con una donna e l'apertura di un misterioso portale gli fanno rimettere in discussione tutta la sua esistenza.

programme.title: Alien Siege
programme.desc: Dopo che un'astronave ha distrutto Washington, D.C., i residenti di una piccola città devono combattere un'unità di soldati alieni che danno la caccia al Presidente degli Stati Uniti e al misterioso dispositivo che sta trasportando, dopo che l'elicottero con cui stava fuggendo atterra proprio nelle vicinanze di quella cittadina.

programme.title: Alien Convergence
programme.desc: Una squadra, composta da persone con disabilità fisiche, sviluppa un rivoluzionario progetto per pilotare gli aerei da combattimento attraverso un collegamento neurale. Quando dalla NASA scoprono che qualcosa sta per entrare nell'atmosfera, tale progetto viene messo in atto per respingere un'invasione aliena.

programme.title: 40 Days and Nights - Apocalisse finale
programme.desc: Se un imponente spostamento tettonico causasse uno tsunami di proporzioni enormi, quale sarebbe l'unica soluzione? Recuperare l'insegnamento di Noè e della sua arca e costruire un'enorme nave capace di contenere solo cinquantamila persone, più il DNA di tutte le specie esistenti al mondo, cercando così di salvarle da una tempesta apocalittica.

programme.title: Marketplace
programme.desc: Canada's consumer watchdog series since 1972, this news program uncovers wrongdoings in the marketplace. With the help of hidden cameras, correspondents dish out the dirt on not so "clean" business practices. Once they get the evidence they need on tape, they apply pressure on businesses to change policies vis-a-vis the products and services they provide to the public.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

programme.title: Los Piratas
programme.desc: Una historia épica, que abarca décadas y continentes, sobre Ioannis Varvakis, un bribón de la época de la Ilustración que se puso del lado de los rusos en su guerra de 1768 contra los turcos, se hizo amigo de Catalina la Grande, amasó una fortuna con el caviar y luego lo donó todo para ayudar a su patria a luchar contra el imperio otomano.

programme.title: La piedra sagrada
programme.desc: Mientras intentan arrestar a un grupo de ladrones, dos agentes del FBI encuentran un antiguo artefacto japonés de enorme poder. Su máxima prioridad será evitar que el artilugio caiga en manos de criminales.

programme.title: Catástrofe en la Tierra
programme.desc: Después de un destello en el cielo, la Luna desaparece. Tras un segundo destello, nadie recuerda nada. Once meses después la Tierra se ha convertido en un lugar postapocalíptico, ya que fue absorbida por un agujero de gusano. Rodeados de catástrofes naturales constantes y sin forma alguna de civilización, los supervivientes deberán encontrar un lugar seguro donde volver a empezar.

programme.title: La Jungla
programme.desc: Una criatura despiadada y mortal para el hombre se esconde en la jungla de Indonesia. Un equipo de expertos se adentra en la naturaleza para encontrar al leopardo que está aterrorizando a la población local. Pero lo que no saben es que están a punto de descubrir una nueva especie depredadora que no teme a los humanos.

programme.title: Robot Apocalypse
programme.desc: Cuando la experta hacker Tara intenta detener a una poderosa inteligencia artificial que se apodera del ejército mundial, la inteligencia artificial la considera una terrorista que debe ser exterminada.

programme.title: Arachnid
programme.desc: Una expedición científica que investiga el brote de una epidemia vírica desconocida en una isla del sur del Pacífico se enfrenta a una araña alienígena gigante en la jungla.

programme.title: El mundo del triasico
programme.desc: Los científicos consiguen dar vida a los dinosaurios para extraer sus órganos y salvar a los humanos. Pero cuando las criaturas escapan, los científicos tienen que luchar por sus vidas.

programme.title: El asesino de al lado
programme.desc: El arquitecto Jonathan se muda a un complejo de apartamentos con patio de Los Ángeles, entonces uno de sus vecinos es asesinado por error.. Jonathan era la víctima prevista.

programme.title: Collider
programme.desc: En el año 2033, una joven atrapada en un misterioso orfanato viaja imprudentemente al pasado para encontrar a sus padres y enmendar su pasado.

programme.title: Cut off (esp)
programme.desc: El policía forense Paul Herzfeld encuentra dentro de la cabeza de un cuerpo mutilado una cápsula que contiene un número de teléfono y el nombre de su hija.

programme.title: Boost
programme.desc: Cuando Jimmy encuentra un paquete misterioso en el maletero del último coche que roba, se ve envuelto en un violento mundo criminal y en una carrera contrarreloj para salvar la vida de una niña.

programme.title: American Yakuza
programme.desc: Un agente americano del FBI es atraído por la mafia japonesa -la Yakuza- en esta película de acción.

programme.title: Esto no es un atracto
programme.desc: Dos chicos de instituto que no consiguen ligar son víctimas de una broma de dos chicas.

programme.title: Asalto al Cine
programme.desc: Unos jóvenes en México planean un atraco a un cine, sin saber que sus vidas van a cambiar drásticamente tras el crimen.

programme.title: Midnight Heat
programme.desc: Un banquier amnésique se cache de la police lorsqu'il est accusé du meurtre de sa femme.

programme.title: Death Match : Dans l'Arène de la Mort
programme.desc: Un champion de kickboxing et un journaliste sont à la recherche d'un homme disparu, mais ils découvrent une série de matchs de kickboxing illégaux organisés par un marchand d'armes.

programme.title: Erik le Viking (VOST FR)
programme.desc: Le chef viking Thorvald meurt d'une blessure mortelle au combat. Il se rend compte que son fils Erloff n'est pas un digne successeur, mais son testament répartit ses biens à parts égales entre lui et Erik, le valeureux fils de sa sœur, qui reçoit également ses armes et la mission de mener une expédition maritime à la recherche de nouvelles terres pour y établir une colonie, cruciale car leur village natal scandinave ne pourra pas résister à la puissance du royaume danois.

programme.title: Every Last One of Them
programme.desc: Un homme est à la recherche de sa fille disparue, mais sa recherche révèle un complot plus vaste impliquant un gros accord capitaliste qui fait dérailler Chinatown sur les droits de l'eau.

programme.title: Awaken
programme.desc: Un groupe de personnes se réveille sur une île où elles sont pourchassées.

programme.title: Exit Speed
programme.desc: Dix passagers d'un bus se retrouvent bloqués dans une casse après avoir été chassés de la route par des motards. Pour survivre, ils doivent improviser des armes et avoir le courage de se défendre contre les motards meurtriers.

programme.title: La Colonie
programme.desc: Des groupes de personnes – des colonies – sont forcés de vivre sous terre à cause d'une nouvelle ère glaciaire. La Colonie 7 part vérifier la situation de la Colonie 5, avec laquelle ils ont perdu le contact. Sur place, ils découvrent que la colonie est tombée et qu’un tout nouvel ennemi les attend sur le chemin du retour.

programme.title: Incoming
programme.desc: La station spatiale internationale est désormais une prison - le site noir par excellence. Personne n'en sort. Et personne ne sait qu'elle est là. Mais lorsque les terroristes emprisonnés prennent le contrôle de la station et la transforment en un missile visant Moscou, seuls un pilote de navette et un médecin débutant peuvent les arrêter. Leur tâche est compliquée par un agent de la CIA véreux (Scott Adkins) qui a ses propres plans pour la station et les terroristes qui s'y trouvent.

programme.title: Crash lunaire
programme.desc: Deux entreprises, l'une sidérurgique et l'autre aérospatiale, décident de s'associer afin d'exploiter les ressources de la Lune. Mais, un accident de forage provoque une fissure et précipite un morceau de l'astre sélène vers la Terre.

programme.title: Special ID
programme.desc: Chan Chi-Lung est infiltré depuis des années dans le gang triadique hongkongais de Cheung Mo-Hung. Suite à l'échec d'une récente négociation menée par Lung avec les trois autres triades locales pour le compte de Hung, ce dernier commence à douter de son identité. Hung entreprend alors d'éliminer tous les policiers infiltrés de son gang, et nombre d'entre eux sont capturés et tués. Pressentant le danger, Lung demande à son capitaine, Cheung, de mettre fin à sa mission d'infiltration. Cependant, Cheung l'envoie en Chine continentale pour infiltrer un trafic de personnalités protégées . Ce trafic est dirigé par Sunny, le protégé de Hung et ancien camarade de Lung au sein du gang. Cheung promet de rétablir l'identité policière de Lung à la fin de la mission, une fois le trafic de Sunny ruiné. Lung accepte, accompagné de l'inspectrice Fang Jing et de son supérieur, Lei Peng, de la police chinoise. Mais avant qu'ils ne puissent atteindre Sunny, cette dernière disparaît soudainement, laissant Lung sans défense et en grand danger.

programme.title: Le Manteau de Chicago
programme.desc: Le Chicago Outfit fut le syndicat du crime organisé le plus puissant du XXe siècle, et Lou Marazano (Frank Vincent) en était le tueur à gages le plus redouté.Vingt ans après sa vague de meurtres la plus célèbre, Lou est devenu une relique : sa légende s’est effacée, son talent oublié, et ses heures de gloire sont derrière lui.Mais lorsque l’arrestation d’un influent représentant syndical pour fraude fiscale menace de révéler une vaste conspiration impliquant policiers, élus et mafieux, le grand patron du Outfit (Armand Assante) ordonne l’élimination de témoins-clés.Pour Lou, c’est l’occasion rêvée de financer sa retraite et de fuir Chicago avec sa compagne (Kathrine Narducci).Mais deux détectives tenaces (Danny Goldring et Stacy Keach) se lancent à ses trousses, et le parrain par intérim (Mike Starr) décide de l’exclure du Outfit.Lou va devoir prouver qu’il mérite toujours son titre d’homme de main le plus meurtrier du Chicago Outfit — un titre qu’il n’a plus porté depuis plus de vingt ans…

programme.title: Java Heat
programme.desc: L'histoire se concentre sur les conséquences d'un attentat-suicide en Indonésie, où un Américain imprudent se faisant passer pour un étudiant diplômé cherche à se venger.

programme.title: Funeral Killers
programme.desc: Un jeu du chat et de la souris se déroule au cours d'une seule nuit, lorsque trois criminels armés font irruption dans une morgue et exigent que le médecin légiste et son assistant leur remettent une balle logée dans un cadavre. Alors que les criminels tentent désespérément de cacher leur véritable identité, le médecin se retrouve de plus en plus enlisé dans un bourbier, son passé le rattrapant malgré lui. Chaque rebondissement explosif pousse bientôt les personnages au-delà de leurs limites.

programme.title: La Prison
programme.desc: UN ANCIEN POLICIER CONDAMNÉ REJOINT UN SYNDICAT DU CRIME SECRET AU SEIN DE LA PRISONYu-gon (KIM Rae-won), ancien inspecteur de police tourmenté, est incarcéré pour un délit de fuite. En prison, il découvre que tout l’établissement est contrôlé par un détenu nommé Ik-ho (HAN Seok-kyu), qui dirige un syndicat du crime avec l’aide du directeur et des gardiens, leur fournissant ainsi l’alibi parfait. Rapidement, Yu-gon devient un membre clé de l’empire criminel d’Ik-ho.

programme.desc: Une famille de pionniers est presque entièrement détruite par des Indiens en quête de vengeance : Le petit George est laissé évanoui sur le sol, et sa petite sœur adoptée par le chef indien. Le destin les réunira à nouveau.

programme.desc: Sept bandits masqués enlèvent la jeune Susy, cousine du maire de Clayton City, Frank Clonny. Frank accepte la rançon de 15 000 dollars demandée par les bandits et réfléchit à un plan qui lui permettra de récupérer l'argent et de capturer les hors-la-loi.

programme.title: Inside New York

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: Einst war es das höchste Gebäude der Welt. Auch heute noch ist seine Präsenz in der Skyline von New York City unübertroffen: das Empire State Building. programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: Der New Yorker Hafen ist ebenso groß wie komplex. Er beherbergt eines der kritischsten Infrastruktursysteme der USA: sechs Containerterminals, die jeden Tag Millionen Kilos an Fracht ein- und ausladen. Dieses System wird von Tausenden von Arbeitnehmern getragen - von Schlepperkapitänen über die Küstenwache bis hin zu Hafenarbeitern.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: Die Skyline von New York verändert sich ständig, da die Stadt immer weiter wächst. Der Bau von Hochhäusern in New York bringt jedoch eine Reihe von Herausforderungen mit sich, wie das dichte U-Bahn-Netz und der allgemeine Platzmangel. programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: In New York City gibt es das beste Essen - zumindest, wenn man die New Yorker fragt. Das meiste davon kommt von einem zentralen Punkt in der Bronx: dem Hunts Point Distribution Center. Jedes Jahr werden von dort aus 2 Milliarden Kilo Lebensmittel an die Restaurants, Lebensmittelgeschäfte und Bodegas der Stadt geliefert.

programme.title: Inside New York

Die Berufsfeuerwehr ist weltweit führend in Sachen Innovation, aber sie ist auch von Tragödien geprägt. programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: New York City ist das Herzstück des amerikanischen Eisenbahnsystems. In seinem Zentrum steht das Grand Central Terminal. Der Bahnhof im Beaux-Arts-Stil zieht seit über hundert Jahren Touristen und Pendler gleichermaßen an. Doch um alles am Laufen zu halten, sind Hunderte von Schaffnern, Bahnhofsmanagern und Rettungskräften erforderlich.

programme.title: Inside New York
programme.desc: New York mag zwar das beste öffentliche Nahverkehrssystem Amerikas haben, aber seine Straßen sind genauso wichtig. Damit alles reibungslos funktioniert, braucht es Streumittel, Kehrmaschinen, Tausende von Kameras und jede Menge Asphalt.

programme.title: Inside New York

programme.title: Inside New York

programme.title: La liberté à tout prix
programme.desc: Allemagne de l'Est, 1984 : Frank Korbach se réjouit de fréquenter l'école d'art dramatique, tandis que son meilleur ami rebelle Thomas refuse de faire son service militaire. Avec l'aventureux mais naïf Alex, Thomas projette de faire une tentative désespérée de fuite vers l'Ouest. Sachant qu'il ne les reverra peut-être jamais, Frank accompagne Thomas et Alex à la frontière. Soudain, ils sont confrontés à une unité spéciale de la Stasi, la police secrète est-allemande. Bien que les garçons parviennent à éviter la capture, l'ancienne vie de Frank a disparu à jamais - il est maintenant devenu un fugitif. Le père de Frank, Kurt Korbach, est stupéfait par cette évasion. Kurt est un major de la Stasi, à l'insu de son fils. Convaincu que Frank est innocent, il persuade ses supérieurs que lui seul peut ramener son fils. Avec le suspect colonel Frey - une bombe à retardement prête à exploser - Kurt se met en route pour retrouver les garçons en fuite.

programme.title: Les Bienheureux
programme.desc: Alger, quelques années après la guerre civile. Amal et Samir ont décidé de fêter leur vingtième anniversaire de mariage au restaurant. Pendant leur trajet, tous deux évoquent leur Algérie : Amal, à travers la perte des illusions, Samir par la nécessité de s'en accommoder. Au même moment, Fahim, leur fils, et ses amis, Feriel et Reda, errent dans une Alger qui se referme peu à peu sur elle-même.

programme.title: Habib, la grande aventure
programme.desc: La vie d’Habib, un jeune acteur bruxellois issu de l’immigration marocaine, qui a l’opportunité de jouer le rôle principal dans un film sur la vie de François d’Assise.

programme.title: The Other Me
programme.desc: Un architecte est atteint d'une maladie oculaire qui l'introduit dans une réalité surréaliste dans laquelle il voit les motivations des gens. Les visions devenant intolérables, il tombe amoureux d'une femme mystérieuse.

programme.title: Présomption d'innocence
programme.desc: Une femme est reconnue coupable d'avoir tué son petit ami et sa meilleure amie dans le feu de la passion bien qu'elle ait été défendue par un avocat de renom. Elle s'enfuit après le procès afin de découvrir qui l'a piégée.

programme.title: Amour, Romance & Chocolat
programme.desc: Emma et le chocolatier Luc concourent pour le titre de chocolatier royal de Belgique. La beauté et le romantisme de Bruges inspirent des combinaisons de chocolat uniques, mais leur projet gagnera-t-il sans qu'ils ne perdent leur cœur ?

programme.title: La montagne du silence
programme.desc: Les deux amies Johanna et Marlies sont spécialisées dans la conception de campagnes de marketing au sein de l'Association autrichienne du tourisme. Lorsqu'on a demandé à Johanna de commercialiser une région montagneuse isolée de Styrie en tant que nouvelle "destination de plaisir", son enthousiasme était limité. La citadine invétérée ne peut rien faire avec les montagnes, les fermes et les cloches qui sonnent. Son amie et collègue Marlies, en revanche, aime les montagnes par-dessus tout et est donc en feu lorsqu'elle se voit attribuer le contrat pour le projet sur la recommandation de Johanna. Elle parvient même à convaincre l'alpiniste de renommée mondiale Ferdinand Plocher de participer à la campagne - et elle s'intéresse aussi personnellement à ce charmant homme de plein air. Tout semble être parfait : Johanna peut rester à Vienne pendant que les Marlies, pleines de vie, se baladent dans les montagnes pour faire des recherches. Jusqu'à ce que Johanna reçoive la nouvelle choquante de la mort de son ami. Stupéfaite et accablée par un profond sentiment de culpabilité, elle se rend en Styrie pour ramener le corps de Marlies à la maison. Elle y retrouve Ferdinand, qui avait flirté sans retenue avec elle lors de sa visite à Vienne, mais qui se retrouve soudain à l'écart. Comme Marlies auparavant, Johanna loue une chambre d'hôte sur l'Almhof au frère de Ferdinand, Jörg, un solitaire amer qui doit s'occuper seul de sa fille malade Veverl. Les querelles constantes entre les frères différents rendent Johanna méfiante. D'autres éléments indiquent également que l'accident d'escalade de Marlies s'est produit différemment de ce qui avait été annoncé. Bien qu'elle rencontre un mur de silence parmi les villageois, elle continue à faire des recherches inlassables. Et même si Ferdinand ne l'aide pas vraiment, les deux se rapprochent émotionnellement. Plus Johanna passe de temps avec l'alpiniste passionné, plus elle apprend à apprécier les montagnes majestueuses et impressionnantes. Elle commence alors à tomber amoureuse de l'homme qui semble le mieux connaître les véritables circonstances de la mort de son amie.

programme.title: Les Babysitters
programme.desc: À 17 ans, Shirley Lyner, lycéenne, pense à l'université et gère un service de baby-sitting qui fournit des call-girls adolescentes aux pères de jeunes enfants. Dans un long flashback, nous voyons ce qui l'a amenée à passer du statut de baby-sitter à celui d'organisatrice et de gérante du service. Tout commence avec Michael, le père des enfants dont elle s'occupe. Une tasse de café sur le chemin du retour, une visite nocturne dans une gare de triage, et les choses s'enchaînent. Shirley peut se montrer impitoyable, et la tension monte lorsque certains clients emmènent les filles dans un chalet à la montagne et apportent de la drogue. Puis, l'une des filles tente de se mettre à son compte. Cela peut-il bien se terminer : est-ce une tragédie en devenir ? Avons-nous tous des secrets ?

programme.title: En Transit
programme.desc: En 1946, un groupe de prisonniers de guerre allemands est envoyé par erreur dans un camp de transit pour femmes soviétiques et doit faire face à l'hostilité des détenues et des gardiennes soviétiques, sous les ordres du cruel commandant du camp, Pavlov.

programme.title: Le carrefour du parc
programme.desc: "Il est midi dans un parc isolé au pied des collines de Los Angeles. - April est venue pour se suicider ; Krysta et Dennis s’échangent des tendresses dans sa voiture tandis que son collègue Ian attend dans une camionnette de lavage pour chiens ; Peg, l’épouse de Dennis, et sa meilleure amie Claire les ont suivis et prévoient une guérilla amoureuse ; et quatre jeunes trentenaires du même bureau discutent dans une autre camionnette. - April demande de l’aide à Ian (du lubrifiant, un tuyau, un briquet), qui lui demande s’il peut l’accompagner. - Claire et Peg piègent les amants dans la voiture de Dennis puis ont une conversation intime. - Nathan et Babar avouent à Meredith et Cheryl qu’ils sont nudistes, tandis que Meredith insiste pour dire que les deux hommes sont gays. Les vêtements tombent et les vérités éclatent. - Est-ce juste une journée de plus à Los Angeles ?"

programme.title: Golem, le Tueur de Londres
programme.desc: Le Londres victorien est terrorisé par un tueur en série inconnu qui laisse des messages énigmatiques écrits avec le sang de ses victimes. Lorsque les meurtres se multiplient, Scotland Yard confie l'affaire à un inspecteur célèbre.

programme.title: La retraite de l'amour
programme.desc: Lorsque la marque de beauté Bloom décide de se concentrer sur les ventes en ligne, Jenny doit trouver comment vivre dans l’équilibre travail-vie personnelle , tandis que Nate a déjà trouvé la solution. Lorsque des étincelles jaillissent entre eux, un seul problème se pose : c’est le frère de son patron...

programme.title: L'Histoire de l'Amour
programme.desc: The story of a long-lost book that mysteriously reappears and connects an old man searching for his son with a girl seeking a cure for her mother's loneliness.

programme.desc: North Korea is a country of stark contrasts. On the one hand, it presents real socialist stereotypes like cryptic messages from a frozen time loop, combined with shocking reports on shortages. On the other hand, polished Pyongyang lures with a futuristic skyline, flashy amusement parks and department stores with a range of goods equal to those in western consumer meccas.

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS, Hitler’s Schutzstaffel, stands for terror and the murder of millions. The penniless graphic artist Walter Heck was given the job of designing the jagged, rune-like characters in 1929. The “sig” rune was rooted deep in the ideological cosmos of the Nazis and their supporters. They saw themselves as the descendants of the Teutons and declared the runes to be humanity’s original Germanic script. The symbol was meant to unite Heinrich Himmler’s “Black Order.” But did it escape their notice that it was originally of Semitic origin? In October 1945, the Allies passed a law banning the Nazi Party and all associated organizations, including the SS. The young Federal Republic even forbade all Nazi symbols. This documentary tells the gripping story of the SS symbol, from the Middle Ages to the present day.

programme.title: Mata Hari - The Beautiful Spy
programme.desc: In February 1917 World War I is raging when Mata Hari is arrested in Paris and taken to the examining magistrate. Her very life is at stake: she is accused of high treason. The famous exotic dancer has come to represent beauty and the power of feminine seduction. The documentary Mata Hari - the Beautiful Spy tracks down the true story of this fascinating woman.

programme.title: The Child Crusades - Barefoot to the Promised Land
programme.desc: In Cologne in 1212 a boy named Nicholas captivated thousands of children between the ages of eight and fifteen with his fanatical speeches. They had been chosen, he said, to liberate Jerusalem. Likewise, in the French town of Cloyes a young shepherd gathered numerous children around him with the same proclamation.

programme.title: Forest of Heroes
programme.desc: From Lower Saxony and North Rhine Westphalia, from Osnabrück to Paderborn, one of Germany’s most beautiful forests extends for some 150 kilometers - the Teutoburg Forest. The low mountain range became famous due to the Varus Battle that took place in 9 AD. It was here that Hermann, or Arminius, the Cherusci Prince vanquished the Roman occupation army.

programme.title: The Battle for the Baltic Sea
programme.desc: It’s in spring 2008, when the telephone of the Archaeological State Office Schleswig-Holstein suddenly rings. The message archeologist Martin Segschneider receives makes him curious.

programme.title: Operation Peter Pan - The Secret War against Cuba
programme.desc: In 2016, a historic moment arrived when Barack Obama spoke in Cuba to the inhabitants of the island nation and promised a future together. For the first time in more than 50 years, an American president had entered the communist country and turned towards an erstwhile enemy. However, the US economic embargo against Cuba continues. It sanctions the socialist state – although the UN General Assembly recently again called it a violation of international law. Many Cubans are therefore sceptical about a new political future, despite the friendly words of the American President. Their distrust is deep. It is based on over fifty years of history and the policies of the United States towards their country. For years, the Cuban government has raised serious allegations against their big neighbour. The film "Operation Peter Pan" tracks these allegations.

programme.title: Monsters and Myths
programme.desc: Monsters have always been part of our nightmares and fairy tales. But where do they actually come from? How much of them is truth, how much is myth? Going to great lengths in this documentary, the filmmakers join scientists to explore a number of the best known sagas and legends in the world.

programme.title: World War A - When Aliens Attack
programme.desc: Scientists are already looking feverishly for evidence of extraterrestrial life. With the ExoMars mission, ESA will soon find life on Mars. If there are only tiny microbes, there could also be life in other places in the universe. But can life in space exist at all? The exobiologist Jean-Pierre de Vera collects microorganisms around the world and tests them in his Mars simulation laboratory. Can they survive under the deadly conditions of Mars? Researchers believe there are planets on which alien life can exist. In 1991 the Swiss astrophysicist Michel Mayor discovered the world's first exoplanet. Since then, about 3,000 planets have been detected outside our solar system. Heike Rauer from the German Aerospace Center is looking for habitable planets. Will she find a second earth? The European Southern Observatory is also searching for life in space, building the largest telescope in the world. In the next 20 years the E-ELT should be able to prove the existence of life on distant planets. How would extraterrestrials look? Some scientists suspect that they may well resemble us humans. Under other environmental conditions, alien life could also arise completely differently. It could be formed from methane and silicon. Different gravity would form alien bodies completely differently. Could extraterrestrials send us messages? At the SETI Institute in California, alien hunters like Seth Shostak are listening to signals from alien civilizations. But mere listening is no longer enough. Some SETI researchers now want to send messages to the aliens themselves. They hope to finally get an answer. But would that be a bad idea? Many scientists warn of the dangers of establishing contact. The former SETI researcher and science fiction author David Brin also fears that it could be a devastating mistake. With well-meant news we could end up attracting attention from hostile civilizations. Should we really tell them that we exist and where they can find us?

programme.title: UFOs and the Cold War

programme.title: Crime Scene Eulau - The Mystery of the 13 Skeletons
programme.desc: This documentary focuses on a spectacular discovery made in a quarry near the village of Eulau, not far from the central German town of Naumburg. Neolithic graves contained the skeletons of three women, two men and eight children, buried tenderly 4500 years ago, some affectionately entwined. In 2008, for the first time anywhere in the world, it was possible to perform a DNA analysis on the earliest evidence of the existence of a nuclear family. This was a sensation - but why did these people all die at the same time? Were they the victims of a violent crime? Who were they, and how did this terrible drama unfold? Archaeologists insist that these victims will not be forgotten, since these days it is possible to do far more than simply date and record such finds. Modern scientific methods have revolutionised archaeology, enabling us to discover how and why the family from Eulau in the German state of Sachsen-Anhalt died 4500 years ago. By enlisting the help of a CID profiler, archaeologists and anthropologists employ state-of-the-art analytical methods to investigate this Stone Age crime. In the process we discover key information about an era before recorded history which has previously been shrouded in mystery - and astonishing information about the composition of the population here also comes to light. It seems that the third millennium before Christ saw two major waves of migration, from Eastern and Western Europe, which determine the composition of the population here. In the middle of what is now Germany these two migratory movements met. Could this be the background to the mysterious murders of Eulau?

programme.desc: Guido (Filippo Timi), un ancien policier, est un vétéran malchanceux des speed-datings à Turin. Mais, à sa grande surprise, il rencontre Sonia (Ksenia Rappoport), une immigrée slovène qui travaille comme femme de chambre dans un hôtel de luxe. Entre eux, le courant passe et une romance passionnée naît. Après avoir quitté la ville pour une escapade romantique à la campagne, les choses prennent soudainement une tournure sombre. Le passé trouble de Sonia refait surface et sa réalité commence à s’effondrer. Tout change dans sa vie : des questions surgissent et les réponses n’arrivent qu’au fil de rebondissements qui tiennent le spectateur en haleine jusqu’aux dernières minutes du film. LA DOUBLE HEURE, lauréat du prix de la meilleure actrice à la Mostra de Venise 2009, est réalisé par Giuseppe Capotondi.

programme.title: My Pacific Quest
programme.sub-title: My Pacific Quest S01 E05 - The Marshall Islands
programme.desc: The Marshall Islands have a long human history, but it is the more recent saga that was thrust upon them during World War II and its aftermath that draws host Ellis Emmett to its shores. Following the Allied victory, the United States moved the local inhabitants from their quiet paradise in order to conduct atomic bomb testing at the famous Bikini Atoll. Ellis explores how, almost 65 years later, both the people and environment continue to be affected.

programme.title: My Pacific Quest
programme.sub-title: My Pacific Quest S01 E06 - Kiribati NB
programme.desc: For thousands of years, the island peoples of the Pacific were masters of the ocean, sailing across the waves in handmade canoes and navigating by the stars. But, these traditional ways and sailing knowledge are being lost to technology. Host Ellis Emmett helps get a traditional canoe back on the water, and sees first-hand how rising seas are changing life in the island chains of Kiribati.

programme.title: Transcend
programme.desc: Maranda spent her life looking for a protector, only to find herself lost in a cycle of toxic love and betrayal. From the wreckage of abandonment to a life-altering crossroads, her survival isn't just about escaping the past, it’s about surviving herself.

programme.title: Eyes From Eden
programme.desc: A drummer sacrifices the integrity of his faith to satisfy his unfulfilled desires once he meets an exotic woman named Eden.

programme.title: Family Over Everything
programme.desc: After being set up to get jumped, West now owes the biggest Street hustler in Syracuse, Gunzo $50,000. But when Gunzo’s crew shows up at West’s family home, his older sibling’s step in to protect the family from his wrath.

programme.title: The Hanged Man
programme.desc: The astonishing true life story of Ron Van Clief, the first black martial arts movie star, known as “The Black Dragon”. His determination to win, despite horrific odds, exacts a heavy toll with spectacular highs and devastating lows.

programme.title: The Perfect Wife
programme.desc: A young freelance photographer in Houston meets a beautiful determined teacher from Atlanta. His best friend tries to warn him about her. There is something a little strange about Claudia. Q loves her dearly but she may not be The Perfect Wife.

programme.title: The Perfect Wife 2
programme.desc: The Styles Girls relocate to a new state to start over after the loss of the only place they knew. Unbeknownst to them, the secrets they left behind surface within the walls of their new residence.

programme.title: Sinful Paradise: Welcome to Paradise
programme.desc: Follows the women and operators of Paradise, one of the hottest gentleman’s club in Atlanta, with high profile clients and beautiful women, and one of the only female owned clubs in the city. The owner, Cat, and her business partner SP protect their dynasty, and follows the stories and obstacles of its dancers.

programme.title: Loyalty and Larceny
programme.desc: Broke couple Deon and Tiff accidentally steal a package of premium weed meant for a local dealer working under Queen Pin. Forced to become rookie dealers in Dallas to pay off their debt, they fumble their way through the drug game while trying to survive the ruthless Queen Pin and a vengeful rival, C-Mo. When they uncover a deeper betrayal, they must fight for their lives and a shot at running their own LA empire.

programme.title: GRIT
programme.desc: Three estranged brothers, Jason Jarell, and Josiah, are brought together by their sister Laura’s death. The brothers make a pact to uncover the truth behind her murder, setting off a perilous journey into the dark political world, where they forge unexpected alliances in order to get justice for Laura.

programme.title: The Devil Came to Duval
programme.desc: After surviving a suicide attempt, comedian Eli Thompson faces his past on his birthday, but a night out at the bar spirals into chaos when the Devil arrives. Eli must confront betrayal, revenge, and supernatural terror to survive.

programme.title: Taking What's Mine
programme.desc: Jordan Hayes, a decorated Army veteran turned rising political icon is thrown into a harrowing disaster when her journalist husband, Ethan, is captured by a rising terrorist leader, Khalid Rami. Rami will only release Ethan if Jordan helps overturn a new counter terrorism bill. Refusing to fight the red tape and bow to pressure, Jordan takes matters into her own hands and sets out to rescue him herself.

programme.title: ToxiCity
programme.desc: Corey Spencer, the innovator behind the successful ATLUV dating app, navigates a complex personal life. Despite his app's mission, he struggles with love, further complicated by a child support order. A night out leads him to Sierra, an alluring actress who quickly moves in. Their romance sours as Sierra's past as a dancer and her aggressive jealousy come to light.

programme.title: We in This Together
programme.desc: Attorney August marries Daisha, a social climber more interested in his bank account than motherhood. To hide her infertility, Daisha secretly adopts 17-year-old "Lil August," sparking an immediate, violent rivalry. While August dismisses the teen’s lethal behavior as "playful," Daisha finds herself trapped in a house with a son who may be a killer. As she plots to conceive a biological heir, a series of dark secrets and "accidents" leave the family’s survival in question.

programme.title: Don't Miss the Bus
programme.desc: Sierra, a single mother hustles in order to survive with long shifts and grunt work. Her faith is pinned on lottery tickets and men who exploit her vulnerability. When a stroke of luck has the ability to change her future forever, a missed bus stop could mean life or death.

programme.title: Broken Harmony
programme.desc: Recording artist Harmony Brown, listens to every suggestion from her record label including changing her sound, changing her look, and even changing the type of music she sang. Yet, her numbers aren’t improving, and she’s on the verge of being released from her contract. Her manager, suggests she returns to Atlanta and meet with a power house music producer to give her a refresh on her sound. However, she’s forced to stay with and reunite with her mother, and address the trauma of her childhood.

programme.title: Monster Jam Replay
programme.desc: The Monster Jam action intensifies as elite drivers push their trucks to the edge in a high-energy showdown packed with momentum swings and jaw-dropping saves. Racing, skills, and freestyle runs collide as rivalries heat up and the leaderboard stays in constant motion, with massive air, hard landings, and razor-thin margins separating the field. From aggressive charges out of the gate to freestyle moments that bring the crowd to its feet, every run carries championship implications. With no room for mistakes, this episode delivers nonstop Monster Jam spectacle and sets the tone for an unforgettable stretch of competition.

programme.title: Monster Jam Fast Track
programme.desc: The ground shakes as Stadium Championship Series West takes over the legendary Angel Stadium for a high-octane showdown in Anaheim. Watch as fearless competitors push 1,500-horsepower machines to their absolute limits across three grueling competitions: JCB Racing, the technical Skills Challenge, and the fan-favorite Freestyle.

programme.title: Best of Monster Jam
programme.desc: The 2026 season kicks off with an electric atmosphere as the world’s most elite drivers descend upon Brooklyn and Tampa for a showcase of raw power and technical brilliance. Witness the intensity reach a fever pitch during the first "father and son" Racing matchup of the year, where family ties are set aside in the pursuit of the next round. Competitors push their machines past the breaking point in Freestyle, featuring high-stakes maneuvers like the Morgan & Morgan backflip and a spectacular "Maximum moonwalk" performed from never-before-seen angles. With hoods flying and trucks performing impossible cartwheels to save their runs, this episode captures every heart-stopping moment of a lineup coming out "swinging with a ton more energy".

programme.title: Best of Monster Jam
programme.desc: Experience the absolute peak of monster truck mastery in this compilation of the best moments from January 2026. Fearless drivers push their 12,000-pound machines to the limit, featuring mind-bending stunts like Weston Anderson balancing his truck on a single BKT tire. The intensity reaches a fever pitch during Freestyle as competitors launch toward the Morgan and Morgan backflip ramp, including a spectacular backflip-to-double-save maneuver. From drivers tossing steering wheels out the window while mid-stunt to a dramatic "cartwheel to save" as time expires, this episode captures the high-energy atmosphere that only Monster Jam can deliver.

programme.title: Best of Monster Jam
programme.sub-title: The Most WILD Moments From April 2026
programme.desc: Feel the ground shake as the world’s most powerful trucks take over arenas across the country for an unforgettable freestyle showcase. From Tristan England's physics-defying saves to Tyler Menninga's astonishing vertical balancing acts, these drivers leave everything on the dirt. Watch in awe as competitors throw their steering wheels out the window, execute massive corkscrews, and crash through car stacks in a relentless pursuit of the perfect run.

programme.title: Morgan AR P4 - Limitierte Sonderedition
programme.desc: Der Plus 4 ist das erfolgreichste Modell von Morgan. Der AR P4 ist eine limitierte Version, die zum 65. Jubilaum des Modells entstand und von der Rennsportabteilung "AR" aufgebaut wurde. Nur 50 Exemplare dieses Autos wurden jemals gebaut.

programme.title: Caterham 620 R - Ein Exot aus England
programme.desc: Caterham ist eine Marke, die sich ganz klar dem Fahrspaß verpflichtet hat. Der 620 R ist ein Fahrzeug, bei dem das Fahren noch eine Herausforderung ist. Keine elektronischen Helferlein stehen dem Fahrer zur Verfügung. Wie viel Spaß das Gerat macht, hat Motorvision getestet.

programme.title: Der ultimative Porsche-Geheimtipp: Boxster 718 GTS
programme.desc: Der Vierliter-Boxer kehrt zurück in den Boxster. Im GTS muss keiner mehr auf den kernigen Sechzylinder-Sound verzichten. Wie agil fühlt sich das Mittelmotor-Cabrio auf den kurvigen Küstenstraßen Portugals an? Und wie macht sich das manuelle Sechsgang-Getriebe?

programme.title: Porsche 911 Turbo S Cabrio: Sportliche Perfektion oben ohne
programme.desc: Der Porsche 911 Turbo S ist an sich schon ein Traumwagen. Als Cabrio schon fast zu schön. Die Kurven einer Alpenstraße in so einem Gefahrt zu erleben, ist purer Genuss.

programme.title: Tradition trifft auf Moderne: Der Ferrari 488 Spider
programme.desc: Klassisches Handwerk trifft auf ein Rasiermesser-scharfes Kunstwerk. Ferrari hat seine Wurzeln auf der Rennstrecke. Der 488 bringt diese Gene auf die Straße. Motorvision ist seine 670 Pferde ausgeritten.

programme.title: Eleganz für die Westcoast: Der Ferrari California T
programme.desc: Der Ferrari California T - Ebenbild für Luxus und dem Dolce Vita. Und dabei ermöglicht die Rennsporttechnik in dem Cabrio immer wieder den Funfaktor in die Höhe zu treiben. Das hat auch Motorvision ausprobiert.

programme.title: Aston Martin Vanquish Volante - Ein Traum aus Carbon
programme.desc: Der Vanquish Volante - ein Traum aus Carbon. Der Luxusliner spielt ganz oben in der Liga der Supersportler mit. Motorvision nimmt den eleganten Britten unter die Lupe.

programme.title: McLaren 720S Spider Luxury - kein offener Sportwagen ist schneller!
programme.desc: Den McLaren 720S gibt es jetzt auch als Cabrio. In nur 11 Sekunden faltet sich das Dach ins Heck. Seine Fahrleistungen sind atemberaubend.

programme.title: Dieser Stier macht süchtig: Der Lamborghini Huracan Spyder
programme.desc: Wie ein wütender Stier schnauft der Lamborghini Huracan Spyder durch seine vier Endrohre. Sein italienisches Temperament übertragt er mit allen vier Radern auf die Straße. Motorvision hat den Torero gespielt.

programme.title: Maserati GranCabrio MC im Test
programme.desc: Wir testen den Maserati GranCabrio MC mit dem 460 PS starken 4,7-Liter-V8-Motor.

programme.title: Audi TT RS Roadster
programme.desc: Ein Roadster mit knurrigem Rennmotor: Der Audi TT RS hat die legendare 5-Zylinder Sportmaschine unter der Haube. Passt der Kultmotor zu seiner modischen Verpackung?

programme.title: Range Rover Evoque Cabrio
programme.desc: Offroad oben ohne. Das Range Rover Evoque Cabrio öffnet ein komplett neues Kapitel in der Offroadwelt. Ohne Dach schleicht der Land Rover durch die Wälder Europas.

programme.title: Rolls-Royce Dawn: Das luxuriöseste Cabrio der Welt
programme.desc: Ein Cabrio im Sommer zu fahren, ist wohl eine der schönsten Beschaftigungen in der warmen Jahreszeit. Einen Rolls-Royce zu fahren auch. Beides in einem Auto zu vereinen ist sicherlich kaum zu toppen. Der Rolls-Royce Dawn, das luxuriöseste Cabrio der Welt.

programme.title: Wiesmann Roadster MF4
programme.desc: Mit dem MF4 verfügt erstmals ein Wiesmann über V8-Power. Motorvision testet den Retro-Roadster

programme.title: Mit dem Mazda MX5 durch die Transsilvanischen Alpen
programme.desc: Der Transfăgărășan Pass in Rumanien ist einer der aufregendsten Straßen der Welt. Wir sind dort unterwegs mit der Modellpflege des Mazda MX5. Optisch bleibt er der Alte. An Motoren, Ausstattung und Assistenzsytemen haben die Japaner aber Hand angelegt und das kleine Spaßauto noch spaßiger gemacht.

programme.title: Mit dem McLaren 570 GT auf Teneriffa
programme.desc: Der 570 GT soll der erste McLaren sein, der nicht nur sportlich, sondern vor allem langstreckentauglich ist.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: Wir begleiten den US-Car-Händler Frank Slopianka in seinem Camaro zum Drag Racing Event "Race@Airport". Außerdem: das Tuning-Unternehmen Mansory steht für ein Plus an Leistung bei Lamborghini, wie auch beim Mansory Torofeo auf Basis des Huracan.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: Der Nürburgring ist die gefährlichste und zugleich schönste Rennstrecke der Welt und Treffpunkt für Rennsport-Ikonen und -Raritäten. Auch der "Sport1 Trackday" zieht jedes Jahr Tausende von Auto- und Motorsportbegeisterten an.

programme.title: MOTORVISION.TV #SPOTTED
programme.desc: Ola Stenegard, Chef-Designer von BMW Motorrad, trifft in Los Angeles Customizer wie Michael Woolaway und Alan Stulberg. Außerdem: wir zeigen die verrücktesten "Homemade Supercars" wie den Fahrradi Farfalla FFX, den langsamsten Sportwagen der Welt.

programme.title: Kassenschlager: Die BMW GS Serie
programme.desc: Hochwertig, teuer und - weltweit ein Kassenschlager: Seit 1980 ist die BMW GS auf dem Markt, zunachst noch unter dem Namen G Strich S. Damals war sie eine Revolution: ein völlig neuartiges Bike fürs Gelande und für die Straße. Bis heute ist sie eines der erfolgreichsten Motorrader aller Zeiten.

programme.title: Subaru Forester e-Boxer 2020 - Subarus erster Hybrid
programme.desc: Der Forester e-Boxer ist der erste Hybrid von Subaru in Europa. Dabei bleibt die japanischer Marke ihren Grundsatzen treu: Allradantrieb und Boxer-Benziner. Wie spielt das mit der neuen Hybrid-Technik zusammen? Und wie gut funktioniert der Antrieb? Das testen wir in der Lausitz Onroad und Offroad.

programme.title: An Bord bei der Rekordfahrt des Porsche 911 GT2 RS
programme.desc: Porsche hat mit dem 911 GT2 RS einen neuen Rekord für straßenzugelassene Sportwagen auf der 20,6 Kilometer langen Nürburgring-Nordschleife aufgestellt. Die am 20. September im Beisein eines Notars erzielte Bestzeit von 6.47,3 Minuten übertraf selbst interne Erwartungen. Quelle: Porsche
